components.name: Category Chip Pill
components.description: Minimal filter pill with subtle active purple background.
components.css: .ds-chip-pill { padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: none; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip-pill:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); color: #fff; } .ds-chip-pill.active { background: rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Shelf Navigation Arrow
components.css: .ds-arrow-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border: none; color: #8e8aa4; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-arrow-btn:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); color: #fff; }

components.name: View Mode Toggle Button
components.css: .ds-view-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #8b88a8; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-view-btn:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-view-btn.active { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: CloudStream Desktop delivers a dark, immersive, high-performance streaming environment engineered specifically for desktop screens. The interface recedes smoothly into deep void backgrounds (#0C0B12 to #19173A), allowing cinematic poster artwork, high-resolution media banners, and video playback to take primary focus.
keyCharacteristics: Deep 41° gradient background from obsidian #0C0B12 to night violet #19173A
Minimal borderless navigation arrows, action links, and segmented view toggles
Glassmorphic category pills with balanced padding and subtle violet active states
Horizontally centered dark poster badges and semantic metadata tags
Sub-80MB memory performance with 60fps smooth animations and transitions

rules.name: The Content-First Contrast Rule
rules.body: Canvas surfaces remain dark and borderless; bright colors are reserved strictly for content artwork and deliberate user actions.

rules.name: The No-Rim Rule
rules.body: Shelf navigation buttons and secondary action links must never use thick border outlines or harsh container boxes.

rules.name: The Subtitle Restraint Rule
rules.body: Secondary metadata subtitles must remain muted (#8b88a8) and avoid distracting glowing effects.

rules.name: The Flat-Rest Lift-Active Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls rest flat without thick outlines; depth is activated only upon hover or selection.

dos: Do maintain borderless, minimal icon buttons and navigation arrows.
Do center provider tags at the bottom of poster cards with dark frosted backing.
Do use exponential easing (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for all micro-interactions.
Do ensure all text maintains high contrast against dark canvas backgrounds.
donts: Don't add thick border rims or heavy glowing boxes around secondary actions.
Don't use neon text-shadow glows on search subtitles or category chips.
Don't clutter shelf titles with loud count numbers when clean minimalism is requested.
